basic_details.job_title: DLSA Seraikella-Kharsawan Member Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Legal Services Authority, Seraikella-Kharsawan (DLSA Seraikella-Kharsawan) has notified 1 vacancy for Member, Permanent Lok Adalat on a contract basis, to be sent by Speed Post or Courier to the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Seraikella on or before 22 October 2026. The engagement is for a term of 5 years or till the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier. qualification.details: Eligibility Conditions: Persons having adequate experience in public utility services (transport service for the carriage of passengers or goods by air, road or water or postal telegraph or telephone service; or supply of power, light or water to the public by any establishment; or system of public conservancy or sanitation; or service in hospital or dispensary; or insurance service; or banking service; or education or educational institutions; or housing and real estate services) are eligible to apply. Applicants must not be convicted in any criminal case or have any criminal case pending against the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be addressed to the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Seraikella. Candidates must send their applications by Speed Post or Courier so that they reach on or before 22.10.2026 by 5 PM. The application must be submitted in the prescribed format provided in the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Conditions: Persons having adequate experience in public utility services (transport service for the carriage of passengers or goods by air, road or water or postal telegraph or telephone service; or supply of power, light or water to the public by any establishment; or system of public conservancy or sanitation; or service in hospital or dispensary; or insurance service; or banking service; or education or educational institutions; or housing and real estate services) are eligible to apply. Applicants must not be convicted in any criminal case or have any criminal case pending against the candidate.

rows.pay: Rs. 2,500/- per sitting and Conveyance allowance as per the Permanent Lok Adalat (Other Terms and Conditions of Appointment of Chairman and Other Persons) Amendment Rules, 2025

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: One recent passport size photograph affixed on the application format Two self-addressed stamped envelopes (Rs. 55/- each) Copies of educational qualification Copies of experience / work profile certificate, if any

rows.details: Notice regarding vacancy of Member in Permanent Lok Adalat, Seraikella-Kharsawan

faq.question: Q1. Is the Member post permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The Member shall hold office for a term of 5 years or till the age of sixty-five years, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q2. What is the remuneration provided for the post?
faq.answer: The post entails a sitting fee of Rs. 2,500/- per sitting and conveyance allowance as per the Permanent Lok Adalat (Other Terms and Conditions of Appointment of Chairman and Other Persons) Amendment Rules, 2025.

faq.question: Q3. What documents and items must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose one recent passport size photograph affixed on the application, two self-addressed stamped envelopes (Rs. 55/- each), and copies of educational qualifications and experience certificates if any.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the application addressed to the Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Civil Court, Seraikella to reach by Speed Post/Courier is 22.10.2026 by 5 PM.
